hits.hook: You need to become addicted to finishing what you started.
hits.text: You need to become addicted to finishing what you started.
hits.draft_en:
A show isn't over when the van is packed.

It's over when you know what you actually made after the booth fee, the gas, and the hours.
hits.video_tip: 10s at the car after teardown. Say line one to camera, then cut to you counting the cash box and subtracting the booth fee on paper.

hits.name: Codie Sanchez
hits.hook: It's wild how much you can get done when you:
hits.text:
It's wild how much you can get done when you:

- silence your phone
- put on headphones
- lock in for 1 hour straight
- delete social apps
- close email 
- listen to loud music
hits.draft_en:
It's wild how much more you sell at a craft fair when you:

- price every item where people can see it
- take tap and card, not just cash
- stand up instead of sitting behind the table
- put your bestseller at eye level
- get an email before they walk away
- write down what sold before you pack up
hits.video_tip: 20s booth walk-through. One quick shot per bullet with the line as on-screen text, ending on you jotting today's sales in a notebook.

hits.name: Codie Sanchez
hits.text:
2021 me: "Passive income is critical"
2024 me: "Passive income is a scam"

LOL. Swing and a miss. Was explaining active vs passive income tax wise but still hysterical. Only fools never change their mind eh? https://t.co/wXbYEE8brJ
hits.draft_en:
First-season me: "I'll remember what sold."

Third-season me: writes it down before the tent comes down.

The Sunday-night guessing game is how good shows get skipped and bad ones get booked again.
hits.video_tip: Split screen, 8s. Left: a crumpled receipt pile and a shrug. Right: a clean tally of today's sales written at the table. Caption the two lines on screen.
